title: VICARIOUS OFFENSE AND NOISE AUDIT OF OFFENSIVE SPEECH CLASSIFIERS: UNIFYING HUMAN AND MACHINE DISAGREEMENT ON WHAT IS OFFENSIVE

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying human annotators of different political affiliations (Democrat, Republican, and Independent) to label first-person offense and predict out-group 'vicarious offense' on political social media posts, and comparing these human annotations against the predictions of nine different machine learning offensive speech classifiers to measure political alignment and disagreement.
